cohort: Women with symptomatic uterine rupture treated at Ayder Referral Hospital in Mekelle, Ethiopia, between January 1, 2009 and December 31, 2013
finding: Uterine rupture remains a significant problem in northern Ethiopia, highlighting the need for improved obstetric care and management of laboring women.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery was a predisposing factor for uterine rupture in 11% of the cases.
